must_haves: One playable video file runs for 12 seconds, plus or minus 1 second.
The first 6 seconds are the original clip, unchanged.
There is no jump at the join.
Her face, hair and clothes stay the same in the new 6 seconds.
She turns and walks out of frame.
The cost is about one 6-second generation.

input.prompt: A seamless continuation of this exact shot, beginning exactly from the provided frame. The same woman with the exact same face, dark curly shoulder-length hair and gray ribbed knit sweater, identical clothes and appearance throughout. She naturally turns her body toward screen right, then walks steadily to the right until she completely exits the frame by the end of six seconds. If seated she first smoothly rises. Natural realistic human movement, consistent anatomy and identity. Her hair and clothing move naturally as she walks. Keep the camera locked completely still, the same framing, same park background, same light and colors; no cut, no zoom, no transition. End on the empty unchanged background after she has walked out. Silent video, no speech, no music, no sound.
